title: A Dallas woman turns a $5.99 Goodwill find into $17,500
summary_full: During a routine shopping trip at Goodwill in Dallas, a lucky resident stumbled upon a rare woodcut by Gustave Baumann for just $5.99. After some investigative research, she uncovered that the piece, titled Bright Angel Trail, was from a limited edition and signed by the artist himself. Ultimately, the artwork fetched an astounding $17,500 at auction, despite minor condition issues, transforming her ordinary day into a remarkable moment of discovery.
